dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What were you thinking of having?

dialogues.speaker: Nezhdanov
dialogues.text: Uh, maybe some milk, some fruit... maybe fries too. And if I could get a Fonta, that'd be perfect.

dialogues.speaker: Nezhdanov
dialogues.text: ...Okay, no. None of that sounds like it's going to fix a bad mood. Who tries to eat healthy when they're in a bad mood? That's just depressing in a different way...
